name: Gradient
summary: A simple object defining a color gradient.

properties.name: backfillEnd
properties.summary: Set to `true` to continue filling with the final color beyond the `endPoint`.
properties.description: On Android, this property is only supported by radial gradients.

properties.name: backfillStart
properties.summary: Set to `true` to continue filling with the starting color beyond the `startPoint`.
properties.description: On Android, this property is only supported by radial gradients.

properties.name: colors
properties.summary: An array of colors, as a color name or hex triplet.
properties.description: For information about color values, see the "Colors" section of [Titanium.UI](api:Titanium.UI).

inlined.name: GradientColorRef
inlined.summary: A simple object consisting of a color and an offset.

properties.name: color
properties.summary: Color value at this point in the gradient, as a color name or hex triplet.
properties.description: For information about color values, see the "Colors" section of [Titanium.UI](api:Titanium.UI).

properties.name: offset
properties.summary: The color's normalized position within the gradient, ranging from 0 (start) to 1 (end).
properties.description:
For a linear gradient, the offset ranges between [startPoint](api:Gradient#startPoint)
and [endPoint](api:Gradient#endPoint).

For a radial gradient, the offset ranges between [startRadius](api:Gradient#startRadius)
and [endRadius](api:Gradient#endRadius).

properties.name: endRadius
properties.summary: For a radial gradient, the radius at the `endPoint`.

properties.name: startRadius
properties.summary: For a radial gradient, the radius at the `startPoint`.
